anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.ota_headline: River Bend Lodge: Luxury Safari Retreat in Addo Elephant National Park
anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Nestled within a private concession of Addo Elephant National Park, River Bend Lodge offers an intimate and luxurious safari experience. Our charming colonial-style lodge provides a tranquil sanctuary with elegant rooms, exceptional service, and direct access to thrilling wildlife encounters. Enjoy personalized game drives, exquisite dining, and warm hospitality that blends refined comfort with authentic bushveld spirit. Unwind by the pool, indulge in spa treatments, and discover the magic of Addo with our expert guides. River Bend Lodge is your gateway to an unforgettable South African safari, loved by locals and discerning travelers alike.
